events.title: Woodstock '69 Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, defining a generation.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million gathered for peace, love, and three days of music. What's your top Woodstock moment or track?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll Tribute
angles.copy: 49 years since the world lost the King. What's your favourite Elvis track or memory of his incredible impact?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, dying days later from his injuries.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Influence
angles.copy: 30 years since the tragic shooting of Tupac Shakur. His influence on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic Album
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still got that swagger.

events.title: 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo single 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Song Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: Original iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: 25 years since the original iPod dropped. Remember shuffling through your 1,000 songs in your pocket?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moments
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday Wish
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy legend.

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Influence
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. An incredibly diverse and influential double record.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years since the world lost the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
